title: Get a permit to busk or perform in public places
what: Get the council's permit before busking or performing in streets or other public places.

laws.title: City of Kalgoorlie-Boulder Activities on Thoroughfares and Trading in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law

sources.title: City of Kalgoorlie-Boulder Activities on Thoroughfares and Trading in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law
sources.locator: cl 6.10, as made, Gazette No. 174, 18 Aug 2000
sources.quote: A person shall not perform in a public place without a permit.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 64, 4 May 2018, Gazette No. 133, 17 Sep 2019); the amendments were not read.

assessment.summary: Performing in public places needs the council's permit.
